en.bdb: Love for the Guru decimates ego

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਗੁਣ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh siaanap surat lakh lakh gun chaturaiee|

en.bdb: One may have millions of wisdoms, consciousness, qualities, meditations, honours, japs,

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਖਪਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh mat budh sudh giaan dhiaan lakhapat vaddiaaiee|

en.bdb: Penances, continences, bathings on pilgrimage centres, karmas, dharmas yogas,

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਲਖ ਸੰਜਮਾ ਲਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਨ੍ਹਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh jap tap lakh sa(n)jamaa lakh teerath nhaiee|

en.bdb: Enjoyments rind recitations of holy scriptures to his credit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਲਖ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲਖ ਪਾਠ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: karam dharam lakh jog bhog lakh paaTh paRhaiee|

en.bdb: But still, if such a person controlled by ego wishes to be noticed by others,

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਓਹੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: aap ganai viguchanaa oh thai na paiee|

en.bdb: He has gone astray and cannot fathom the Lord (and His creation).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: peer mureedhaa(n) pirahaRee hoi aap gavaiee ||18||

en.bdb: If the love prevails between the Guru and the disciple, the sense of ego vanishes (in the thin air).
